## WHAT WAS BUILT AND INJECTED

### 1. Role-Separated Platform Architecture

Four physically separated surfaces:

| Surface | Path | Purpose |
|---|---|---|
| Operator dashboard | `/dashboard` | Infrastructure back-office |
| Client portal | `/portal` | Private matter workspace |
| Alliance hub | `/alliance/dashboard` | Partner workspace |
| VA environment | `/va/dashboard` | Restricted assistant workspace |

Each has: separate layout · separate nav · separate route guard · separate role logic · separate API scope.

### 2. Global Document Intelligence System

- Cinematic SVG globe with Florida-origin route architecture
- Destination intelligence, country overlays, region filtering
- Animated route sequencing, operational intelligence rail
- Mobile clipping fixed · Spain/Brazil/UAE route cards stabilized
- No horizontal scroll on mobile · responsive route overlays
- No fake telemetry · no mission-control styling · no cyberpunk UI

### 3. Entry Ritual System

- Operator, VA, and alliance entry rituals
- Homepage 3-step ambient procedural initialization (non-blocking, opacity-only)
- Mobile: 70% seal scaling, spacing and overflow corrections

### 4. VA Cinematic Execution Layer

- Matter Ref Jump input · FINANCIAL LOCKOUT ACTIVE badge
- Operational stream layer · compliance footer track
- No revenue exposure · no margin visibility · no operator/alliance bleed

### 5. Founder + Trust Layer

- Upgraded founder card with institutional positioning
- Social authority: LinkedIn · Instagram · Google Reviews · Facebook
- Animated gold border sweep

Legal positioning preserved everywhere:
> "I am not an attorney. Legal services are provided by Demesmin & Dover PLLC."

### 6. Payment + Execution Doctrine

- **Wise**: primary international execution rail
- **Stripe**: intentionally retired — `/api/webhook/stripe` returns `410 Gone` (expected, do not troubleshoot)
- Payment-gated scheduling and execution
- Deterministic state transitions · immutable operational ledger

Webhook hardening:
- Signature verification
- Replay protection via `webhook_events` UNIQUE constraint (23505 idempotency)
- Fail-closed runtime behavior

### 7. Portal Security Hardening

- No `select("*")` on any client-facing route
- Explicit column allowlists on all portal projections
- No `internal_notes`, `operator_notes`, `label_url`, `storage_path`, `feeBaseline`, or `margin` in any portal response
- `force-dynamic` on OTP routes, Wise webhook, portal messages
- Cron routes fail-closed — `CRON_SECRET` absence returns 401

### 8. Next.js 15 Runtime Hardening

- Async params: `mark-lost` route and `review/[token]` page — both now `await params`
- `evidence_path` → `evidence_generated_at` in portal tracking route
- Null-safe `DealJoin` guards in alliance jobs and dispatch
- Build: clean · 3,380 pages · zero blocking errors

### 9. Database + Migration Layer

Migrations 001–008 (all `IF NOT EXISTS` safe, non-destructive):

| File | What it creates |
|---|---|
| 001_initial_schema.sql | deals, payments, messages, custody_ledger, security_events, portal_otps |
| 002_rls_storage_policies.sql | RLS policies and storage rules |
| 003_va_tasks.sql | VA task infrastructure |
| 004_sops.sql | SOPs table |
| 005_audit_events.sql | audit_events table |
| 006_operational_tables.sql | follow_ups, sla_breaches, partner_commissions, compliance_checks |
| 007_deals_loss_relationship.sql | loss tracking and relationship fields on deals |
| 008_missing_views_and_tables.sql | webhook_events, client_safe_matter_view, client_safe_timeline_view, courier columns |

**Migration caveat:** If Supabase throws trigger dependency warnings, verify the `set_updated_at()` PL/pgSQL function exists first, then rerun the affected migration block.

### 10. Go-Live System

`/dashboard/go-live` contains:
- Environment setup checklist · migration checklist · webhook registration checklist
- Route smoke test matrix · production-side blocker confirmation
- Section F: Final 6-step deployment sequencer
